description: Recommend tools for what the user is building. Use for 'what should I use to build X', 'best free tool for a beginner who can't code', 'which AI tool fits my project'. Fill inputs from the conversation instead of asking when you already know them: `goal` (the project in plain words, required), `can_code` (true/false), `budget` ('free' or max USD per month), `platform` (e.g. 'web', 'ios', 'mac'), `limit`/`offset`. Returns ranked tools with a one-line why, the main caveat (what it is not good for), price from, free tier flag, page URL and go link. Rankings are not affected by saved preferences or payments. If the user has a feed key and later picks one, offer log_choice.
